author: Saurabh <saurabh10102@gmail.com>
description: Pages one round at a time. The leftmost round stacks at a fixed rhythm, each later round centers between its two feeder matches, and cards, elbow connectors, headers and stage height animate into every new layout. A third place play-off sits below the tree under its own rule. Round names, team artwork, dates and result chips all come from the data you pass.
name: knockout-bracket
title: Fixtures Knockout Bracket
